title: Bangladesh Labour & Salary Tax Rule Pack 2026.2
notes: Seeded from Business Logic Specification v0.2 section 7. EVERY value is 'verify': the sources below are law-firm summaries, not authority. The compliance owner must check each value against the gazetted Bangladesh Labour Act / Rules (as amended 2025-2026) and the Finance Act / NBR orders, then run `npm run rules:verify`. Effective dates of the 2025 amendments are taken as 10 April 2026 (date reported for the Labour (Amendment) Act 2026) and must be confirmed; the Ordinance 2025 may have applied earlier. 2026.2 adds the salary tax exemption, exemption cap and minimum tax used by payroll (WP6), and placeholder slabs for FY 2025-26; all PLACEHOLDERS to verify against the Finance Act / NBR.
